name: CTE — Codigo Tecnico de la Edificacion
description: Validates project documentation against the Codigo Tecnico de la Edificacion (CTE). Checks compliance documentation for DB-SE (structural safety), DB-SI (fire safety), DB-SUA (safety of use and accessibility), DB-HS (health / hygiene), DB-HR (noise protection), and DB-HE (energy saving). Verifies that the declared climate zone and building use are consistent with the applicable CTE requirements.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible
